steps: CDC: cdc-1m replaces cdc-4m: gain 6.15 points >= 5
CDC: cdc-256k replaces cdc-1m: gain 6.84 points >= 5
fixed: fixed-4m stays out: gain 0.99 points over current fixed-16m < 5
fixed: fixed-1m stays out: gain 2.17 points over current fixed-16m < 5
fixed: fixed-256k stays out: gain 3.17 points over current fixed-16m < 5
decision: C* cdc-256k vs F* fixed-16m: gain 17.12; vs same-size fixed fixed-256k: gain 13.95
selection.reason: C* cdc-256k beats F* fixed-16m and the fixed block of the same nominal size by >= 5 points

notes: Chunk identity is BLAKE3-256 of the chunk bytes; FastCDC v2020 uses the fastcdc crate default normalisation (level 1).
Empty files have zero chunks; files of at most max bytes are exactly one chunk.
T per pair = bytes of distinct new-version chunks absent from the old version; class value = mean over pairs; T-bar = mean over classes with equal weight.
fixed-64m is the baseline (selectable=false). t_file_level_* are file-granular baselines (predecessor-like path+content, and content only).
